text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, listen to this! Gold Ship is 
chasing me around again while 
impersonating seafood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Over and over until I hit something...! 
And to make matters worse, Orfe-san was 
waiting where I tried to flee... She stood 
there like a sentinel, completely blocking 
my path, you know?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What, isn't that just business as usual?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's like this every single time, which is 
why it's such a headache. *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, pardon me, but can't you do something 
about this? Surely they'll listen to you, 
at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's usually Journey's job, you 
know. Isn't he coming to stop me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She does try to stop them, but... well, 
she's a very gentle person, so she can't 
really be too strict with them...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: No, I just realized how loved I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!? Jeez, not you messing around 
too...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm not joking around. ...You know that, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... well... I shall invite her to a tea 
party next time. In essence, she merely 
wishes to play with me, after all.
